chain.label: Air Sunshine maintenance record-keeping and practices inadequate; FAA oversight did not detect them
chain.trigger: "at the time of the accident, Air Sunshine's maintenance record-keeping and practices were not adequate"; a non-A&P assistant who had never performed a compression check was left to do the right engine checks unsupervised, and cylinder swaps appeared nowhere in the records

chain.label: Insufficient torque applied to right engine No. 2 cylinder hold-down nuts during undocumented maintenance
chain.trigger: "the simultaneous loosening of two or more of the right engine No. 2 cylinder hold-down nuts resulted from the application of insufficient torque, which was applied by Air Sunshine maintenance personnel during undocumented maintenance"

caused_by.evidence: "no documentation of the repeated checks was found... no records were found indicating that any of the right engine cylinders had been removed since the engine was last overhauled" — deficient practices permitted and concealed the untorqued work

chain.label: Two or more No. 2 cylinder hold-down nuts loose and backed off their studs
chain.trigger: "the hold-down nuts on the two unfractured studs must have become loose and backed off of the studs"; two intact nuts were found loose in the engine compartment

caused_by.evidence: "if a mechanic does not apply enough torque to a nut during maintenance, the nut typically becomes loose soon afterward"

chain.label: Load transfer fractured remaining studs and through bolts in high-stress fatigue, separating the No. 2 cylinder
chain.trigger: "The loss of the cylinder hold-down nuts on the two unfractured studs would have caused the loads to be transferred to the remaining studs and through bolts. The increased load would have been sufficient to initiate and propagate high-stress fatigue fractures"

caused_by.evidence: "two or more of the right engine No. 2 cylinder hold-down nuts became loose and backed off of the studs, which resulted in the remaining studs and through bolts fracturing in high-stress fatigue, allowing the cylinder to separate from the engine"

chain.label: In-flight failure of the right engine during descent through 3,500 feet
chain.trigger: "he heard a bang and saw oil coming out of the right engine cowling"; "the airplane's right engine failed while the airplane was descending through an altitude of about 3,500 feet"

caused_by.evidence: "the No. 2 cylinder was found separated from the engine crankcase at the cylinder flange"; the piston fragmented and the connecting rod and piston fragments separated from the engine

chain.label: Drag penalties from engine damage: windmilling propeller, magnetos protruding through cowling, open right cowl flap
chain.trigger: "a windmilling propeller... yields a penalty of -400 fpm; cowl flap of inoperative engine open... -9 fpm; and protruding magnetos... -4 fpm"

caused_by.evidence: "the engine magnetos had penetrated through the engine cowling" and the propeller "continued 'wind-milling' (turning) slowly" after the failure

chain.label: Pilot's history of below-average flight proficiency
chain.trigger: "the pilot had a history of below-average flight proficiency, including numerous failed flight tests, before the accident flight"; nine failed flight checks and a large number of "unsatisfactory" simulator grades at Arrow Air

chain.label: Pilot elected not to run the in-flight engine failure checklist and immediately secured the engine
chain.trigger: "he did not follow Air Sunshine's procedures for an in-flight engine failure because he knew which engine had failed"; "he did not follow the engine failure checklist because he was 'too busy flying the airplane'"

caused_by.evidence: "his first action after he heard the bang and saw oil coming out of the right engine cowling was to shut down the failed engine"
"the records indicated that the pilot needed to improve his scanning and checklist skills, including response and organization"

chain.label: Pilot failed to fly the engine-out configuration and airspeeds needed to maximize performance
chain.trigger: "Other factors that were most likely caused or controlled by the pilot, including not flying at the recommended airspeeds and flap settings, operating with a bank angle and sideslip that were not in accordance with Cessna's recommended in-flight engine failure configuration, and not maintaining a steady descent, could have degraded the accident airplane's performance"

caused_by.evidence: skipping the checklist left the airplane unconfigured — "Trim Tabs – ADJUST 5° bank toward operative engine with approximately 1/2 ball slip" was never verified, and the right cowl flap was found open
"If the pilot had been more proficient, he might have been able to decrease the descent rate enough to maintain flight and reach land"

chain.label: Airplane could not maintain altitude; descent rate exceeded what was needed to reach the airport
chain.trigger: "the airplane's descent rate was between about 560 and 212 fpm during its descent from 3,500 feet to 2,000 feet and was between 429 and 360 fpm during its descent from 2,000 feet to contact with the water"; "if the average descent rate had been about 200 fpm or less, the airplane would have been able to maintain flight and reach MYAT"

caused_by.evidence: "several factors contributed to the degradation of the airplane's performance and its inability to maintain flight and reach land, including the windmilling propeller, the protruding magnetos, the open right engine cowl flap"
"the windmilling propeller and the protruding magnetos alone were not sufficient to cause the airplane to descend as rapidly as it did"

chain.label: Pilot did not give the required emergency ditching briefing
chain.trigger: "after determining that he was going to ditch the airplane, the pilot failed to conduct an emergency briefing, which was required by the emergency ditching procedures contained in Air Sunshine's General Operations Manual"; the only thing he told passengers was to "calm down"

caused_by.evidence: "once he descended from about 1,500 to 1,000 feet, he realized the airplane could not make it to the airport and that he would have to ditch the airplane" — yet no briefing followed

chain.label: Unrestrained pilot struck his head at water contact and was left incoherent
chain.trigger: "the pilot was not wearing his shoulder harness during the ditching, and, because he was not wearing his harness, he sustained a head injury that reduced his ability to assist passengers after the ditching"

chain.label: Ditching in the Atlantic Ocean 7.35 nm west-northwest of Treasure Cay Airport; airplane substantially damaged and sank
chain.trigger: "flight 527, a Cessna 402C, N314AB, was ditched in the Atlantic Ocean about 7.35 nautical miles west-northwest of Treasure Cay Airport"; adult passengers described the contact with the water as "very hard"

caused_by.evidence: "he realized the airplane could not make it to the airport and that he would have to ditch the airplane"

chain.label: Two passengers died after evacuating; pilot and five passengers received minor injuries
chain.trigger: "one adult and one child passenger died after they evacuated the airplane"; cause of death for the child was "drowning secondary to plane crash"

caused_by.evidence: "the airplane sank within several minutes after contacting the water" and the occupants were in the water about 1 1/2 hours before rescue

"this failure contributed to passenger fatalities... the passengers would have had sufficient time to retrieve and don their PFDs if the pilot had instructed them to do so shortly after the right engine failed"; the two who died were not wearing PFDs
a passenger "took charge of the situation because the pilot was incoherent in the water" and had to give the pilot his PFD
